title: [Bug] Inconsistent usage percentage display between /usage page and CLI
body:
**Bug Description**
in /usage show 73% of week usage used but in cli in right corner show 87% wich info is real? same in claude desktop in usage show 73%

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: ssh-session
- Version: 2.1.22
- Feedback ID: d8ba3eb6-c04b-4588-907d-a031ecc29caf

top_comments.author: EYYCHEEV
top_comments.body:
Experiencing the same issue here.

**My numbers:**
- `/usage` command: **65%** weekly usage
- Web (claude.ai/settings/usage): **65%** (matches CLI)
- **Warning message in CLI**: Says I've used **77%**

The warning popup/message shows a higher percentage than what `/usage` actually reports. Both `/usage` and the web dashboard agree at 65%, but the warning claims 77%.

**Environment:**
- Platform: macOS
- Claude Code version: 2.1.25

This creates confusion about actual usage — the warning is more
